description: Unofficial client-only Fabric mod that renders FishOnMC catches at their recorded physical length.

mods.name: FishOn Fish Scale
mods.description: Client-only, size-aware presentation for FishOn fish items while preserving full-size GUI icons.

releases.notes:
## What's new

- Checks once per Minecraft launch for a newer stable GitHub release after the first world or server join.
- Shows one clickable local chat notice when an update is available.
- Runs asynchronously, keeps failures out of chat, and never downloads or installs updates automatically.
- Validates stable versions and release links before notifying.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer compatible release
- Fabric API 0.141.6+1.21.11 or newer compatible release
- Java 21

## Installation

Download `fishon-fish-scale-0.3.0.jar`, place it in the client instance's `mods` folder, remove older copies, and restart Minecraft. Do not install the `-sources.jar` as the playable mod.

## Verification and safety

All 24 automated tests pass. SHA-256 checksums are attached. Fish measurement and presentation remain client-only: no packets, inputs, automation, item mutation, or server behavior changes. The update check is an unauthenticated GitHub request and sends no Minecraft identity, server, world, gameplay, machine identifier, or telemetry data.

## FishOn Fish Scale 0.2.0

Unofficial, client-only Fabric mod for FishOnMC. It renders identified catches at the physical length already stored on each fish item while preserving normal inventory icon size.

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer
- Fabric API 0.141.6+1.21.11 or newer compatible release
- Java 21

### Installation
Download `fishon-fish-scale-0.2.0.jar` and place it in the client instance's `mods` directory, then restart Minecraft. Do not install the `-sources.jar` as the playable mod.

### Safety
Client rendering only. No packets, network requests, telemetry, inputs, automation, movement, item mutation, or server-side behavior.

### Verification
All 16 automated tests pass. SHA-256 checksums are attached in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

This project is unofficial and is not affiliated with or endorsed by FishOnMC, Mojang, or Microsoft. See the repository README for the development disclosure.

### FishOn visual suite
- Rustic Fantasy 128 fish-only textures: https://github.com/finalpantasy/fishonmc-rustic-fantasy-128
- FishOn Fish Scale: https://github.com/finalpantasy/fishon-fish-scale
- FishOn Standing Camera: https://github.com/finalpantasy/fishon-standing-camera
